title: Marinated Cheese
description: This marinated cheese made with Cheddar, cream cheese, and an herby vinaigrette is a beautiful and tasty option for special occasions and holiday parties.

steps.text: Combine oil, vinegar, pimento, parsley, green onions, garlic, sugar, basil, salt, and pepper in a jar with a tight-fitting lid. Seal the jar and shake vigorously to blend.
Cut Cheddar block in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 1/4-inch slices to form squares. Repeat with cream cheese.

Arrange cheese squares alternately in a shallow baking dish with slices standing on edge. (You can arrange in a single row or in two parallel rows, depending on the size of your dish.) Pour marinade from the jar over top, cover, and refrigerate for at least 6 hours, or overnight.
To serve, transfer slices to a serving platter so they are still arranged in an alternating pattern. Spoon some of the extra marinade over top.

video.description: Make a creamy and cheesy appetizer without firing up your oven! In this video, Nicole makes an easy throwback recipe for marinated cheese. Combining two different types of cheeses, this dish marinates in the fridge for around four hours in a tangy, vinegar based marinade. Dip and serve with a side of crackers.
